stages.action: Choose a validated schema and assign a generated or curated question set. Generated questions are checked in the sandbox and their low, medium, or high level is validated from the reference SQL structure; failures are repaired with the specific rule broken.
stages.privacy: Reference SQL and expected rows remain server-side.

stages.action: Read the task, inspect the schema or data as allowed, write SQL, and run an attempt.
Run the read-only query in an isolated schema and return rows or a database error.
Compare output fields, complete rows, duplicates, values, and required ordering with the private answer contract.
After an incorrect attempt, provide one contextual hint at a calibrated support level; escalate only after a new attempt leaves the same issue unresolved.
Revise and run another query; stop hinting when the task is correct.
Store attempts, hint levels, outcomes, and time for learner history and facilitator review.
Complete a new task in no-help mode with correctness feedback withheld until final submission.
